## Checklist

- [ ] Runs locally and the author has seen it work (screenshot or note below)
- [ ] Placeholder content is clearly labelled as placeholder
- [ ] No story, lore or registry content invented beyond labelled placeholders
- [ ] Any new decision is recorded in `DECISIONS.md` with date and reason
- [ ] Package format changes (if any) are versioned and both tools updated together
- [ ] Tests and checks pass (`npm run check && npm test && npm run build`)
- [ ] README updated if run, build or add-an-episode steps changed
